title: Integrated Transcriptomic and Secretome Proteomic Analysis of Hyperglycemia-Stimulated Endothelial Cells and Screening of Target Compounds.
authors: Shi, Min; Meng, Yongjie; Hou, Bin; Kang, Tianyu; Tu, Huifang; Li, Yanan; Li, Kaixin; Li, Mengnan
one_liner_zh: 该文整合转录组与分泌蛋白组多组学分析高糖诱导内皮细胞损伤，并筛选靶向化合物，其中仅包含少量转录因子调控与分子对接模拟，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作边缘应用，方法可迁移但非核心TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: Endothelial dysfunction is a key driver of diabetic kidney disease (DKD), but its systemic molecular mechanisms remain incompletely decoded. We hypothesized that integrated multi-omics analysis could map hyperglycemia-induced endothelial damage and identify reusable therapeutics. A reusable computational pipeline was applied to integrate transcriptomic/secretome profiles from hyperglycemic endothelial cells and diabetic kidneys. This identified 534 commonly upregulated genes/proteins. Functional enrichment revealed activation of extracellular matrix remodeling, intercellular communication, and inflammation pathways. Cross-database validation refined 278 high-confidence mediators, and protein-protein interaction network analysis pinpointed ten hub genes. Using network pharmacology, we screened an approved drug library, identifying several candidate compounds (e.g., bruceantin, idelalisib) that potentially target this network. Furthermore, transcription factor regulation and exemplary molecular docking simulations (e.g., idelalisib with CTCF/BRD4) provided mechanistic hypotheses for experimental validation. In conclusion, this study establishes a reusable multi-omics framework that delineates endothelial pathogenic mechanisms in DKD and nominates repurposable drug candidates, offering a strategic approach for mechanistic and therapeutic discovery.
abstract_zh: 内皮功能障碍是糖尿病肾病（DKD）的关键驱动因素，但其系统性分子机制尚未完全解码。我们假设整合多组学分析能够描绘高血糖诱导的内皮损伤，并识别可再利用的治疗药物。我们应用了一个可重复使用的计算流程，整合高血糖内皮细胞和糖尿病肾脏的转录组/分泌组谱。这识别出534个共同上调的基因/蛋白质。功能富集分析揭示了细胞外基质重塑、细胞间通讯和炎症通路的激活。跨数据库验证筛选出278个高置信度中介因子，蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络分析确定了十个枢纽基因。利用网络药理学，我们筛选了已批准药物库，识别出几种潜在靶向该网络的候选化合物（例如，bruceantin、idelalisib）。此外，转录因子调控和示例性分子对接模拟（例如，idelalisib与CTCF/BRD4）为实验验证提供了机制性假设。总之，本研究建立了一个可重复使用的多组学框架，描绘了DKD中内皮致病机制，并提名了可再利用的药物候选物，为机制和治疗发现提供了一种策略性方法。
